links.outcome: Standalone AI diagnostic accuracy versus endoscopists without AI
links.effect: Model accuracy 96.35% vs endoscopists 63.87-86.13% (p<0.001); treatment decision accuracy 96.35% vs 78.47-86.13%. Standalone comparison only; no assistance condition tested.
links.quote: The ECMAI-WME model significantly outperformed endoscopists in diagnostic accuracy (96.35% vs. 63.87-86.13%, p < 0.001) and treatment decision-making accuracy (96.35% vs. 78.47-86.13%, p < 0.001).

screen.reason: The study develops and validates a multimodal deep learning model (ECMAI-WME) for endoscopic subepithelial lesion classification, comparing its performance to that of endoscopists (reader study) across external validation cohorts.
